meta.bias_flags_considered: deleted-post bias (uncheckable), survivorship (severe, documented), post-hoc screenshots (none used as primary), edits (fxtwitter returns live text; deleted/edited posts would be missing), conflicting scenarios (flagged per-call as dual_path), no-expiry calls (flagged), target-after-adverse (machine-graded), selective reposting (the 2026-02-08 recirculation is exactly this and is not counted as a second call)
meta.headline_win_rate_policy: NONE PUBLISHED. Sample is incomplete and survivor-biased; per SPEC Part 1 no headline win rate is computed. Per-call grades below are conditional on this caveat.
meta.grading: machine-gradable fields under 'machine' are graded by scripts/research_killa_xbt.py against Hyperliquid BTC daily candles (research/killa_xbt/daily_majors.json); rules in that script (Part 8). Calls without 'machine' get no win/loss grade.
